payload.title: lift_sandbox_pin's _read_beneath and _is_symlink_at are a second owner for reading a tree another party writes without following a link, although untrusted_tree.UntrustedTree is documented as the one way the host reaches such a tree; the two answer the same entries in different words, and _read_beneath opens the last component before it checks its type
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:696-752 (_read_beneath and _is_symlink_at: an O_NOFOLLOW walk per component, O_NONBLOCK, a regular-file check on the descriptor)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:726 (the last component is opened before its type is known)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/untrusted_tree.py:22-30 (UntrustedTree: 'the one way the host reaches such a tree', the same walk, refusals by UntrustedEntryRefused)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/untrusted_tree.py:154-171 (open_file and read: lstat the entry, open it, check the descriptor; read takes a limit)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:783-794 (_refuse_pin_path_through_symlink, called at :767: a third, check-then-use component walk, for the write into the kernel's own worktree; the seat does not race it)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept (ARIA-CRITICAL-214): reading a tree another party writes, without following a link, belongs to untrusted_tree.UntrustedTree, and every host reader reads through it
payload.notes: Registered by the D6-SEC findings clerk from the D6-SEC review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head d460f7917 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: UntrustedTree gains one entry accessor that answers missing, regular file (its bytes, bounded by a limit the caller passes), link target or other; lift_sandbox_pin reads through it; _read_beneath and _is_symlink_at are deleted; the write-side guard moves to the same owner, or its different job (a kernel-made worktree no seat races) is stated at its definition. Tests: the probe's six paths get one answer each through the one reader; the ARIA-LOW-971 swap test (a parent directory swapped for a symlink) still gets red_first_pin_path_escapes_worktree; a FIFO or a device node as the last component is never opened.
